# Fortex Appliance Repair

> Licensed (CA #50759) and insured appliance repair across Orange County, CA. Technicians come to the customer; there is no walk-in shop. Service visit is waived with any repair. 1-year warranty on OEM parts, 90 days on labor.

- Phone: (949) 478-0089
- Email: fortexappliancerepair@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat 9am–6pm, Sunday closed
- Based in: Huntington Beach, CA (mobile service, no walk-in shop)
- Book online: https://www.fortexappliancerepair.com/book/

## Pricing and warranty

- The diagnostic visit is $80. If you go ahead with the repair, the diagnostic fee is waived. After checking the appliance, we explain the findings and give you the repair price before work begins.
- Warranty: 1-year warranty on OEM parts, 90-day labor.
